failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh dry-run does not detect stale heartbeat files or display 'Found N' summary with '--force' hint
failures.fix: Fix sw-cleanup.sh to scan for and report stale heartbeat files in dry-run mode and output a 'Found N items' summary with '--force' hint when items are detected

failures.root_cause: sed invocation in sw-code-review-test.sh is missing the -e flag, causing the substitution expression 's|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g' to be interpreted as a filename instead of a script
failures.fix: Add -e flag to the sed command: sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g" instead of sed "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"
